title: Filters
summary: Footage treated as printed comic art (flat inks, key lines, Ben-Day dots, aged paper) plus impact accents for cuts, shown on the sample clip. Previews run at full strength; print looks hold up at half.
usage: As the footage look: {"look": {"name": "inked_print", "amount": 0.6}}. In a footage storyboard: {"name": "impact_burst", "at": 2.4, "seconds": 0.4, "amount": 0.9}. On a shot candidate: {"effect": {"name": "speed_lines", "amount": 0.7, "where": "in"}}. Own effects: library/themes/comic/effects/theme_effects.py; the rest come from library/_shared/effects_engine.py.

items.name: inked print
items.description: The theme’s base look: footage redrawn as flat inks in a few steps with black outlines, dot shading in the shadows and a cream paper cast. Use at 0.5–0.8 as the footage look.

items.name: benday dots
items.description: Colour printed the cheap way: cyan, magenta and yellow dot screens at different angles on paper, under a black key line.

items.name: fourcolor print
items.description: A limited set of flat inks with the colour plates slightly out of register and a black key line.

items.name: newsprint
items.description: Old newsprint: faded colour on yellowed, blotchy paper with specks, soft blacks and browned edges.

items.name: manga ink
items.description: Black and white: solid ink shadows, bare paper highlights and a dot screen for the greys between.

items.name: pop duotone
items.description: Pop-art poster: red shadows and yellow lights joined by dots, blue in the darks, with ink lines.

items.name: impact burst
items.description: A hit: a jagged yellow-and-white burst closes in from the frame edges behind black zoom lines, then the frame flashes. For cuts and punchlines.

items.name: speed lines
items.description: Ink zoom lines converge on the middle of the frame from every edge, redrawn on twos. For emphasis on the speaker.

items.name: panel shake
items.description: The frame becomes a panel that takes a hit: it jolts and tilts on twos, showing paper gutter, its ink border and hard shadow.

items.name: whip
items.description: A fast sideways smear: the whip-pan between panels.

items.name: zoom blur
items.description: A radial rush toward the centre.

items.name: camera shake
items.description: A smooth handheld jolt.

items.name: flash
items.description: A white flash for cuts.

items.name: vignette
items.description: Darkened corners, like ink soaking toward the panel edge.

items.name: grain
items.description: Fine print noise.

items.name: spotlight
items.description: A warm pool of light from above on the person; the room falls away to near-black. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: rim light
items.description: Dark, cool scene; a thin bright outline traces the person. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: flashlight
items.description: A hard round beam on the face that drifts a little; everything else dark. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: golden hour
items.description: Low warm sun with leaf shadows dappled across the scene. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: neon
items.description: Hot magenta from one side, a cyan touch from the other, dark in between. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: projector
items.description: A bright lamp flaring behind the head through haze, teal room. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: under light
items.description: Light from below: the campfire or horror look. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: low key
items.description: Mostly shadow: one small key on the face, deep blacks. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: silhouette
items.description: Bright hazy background, the person a dark shape with a faint edge. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: cop lights
items.description: The room drops dark and red and blue police lights strobe across the person from both sides. Options ("props"): color, color2 (hex), speed (flashes per second, 2.2), push (1.08).

items.name: colour grade
items.description: The look changes on a word: moody, warm, cool, black and white or pop fades in (or ripples out from a point). Options ("props"): grade (moody, warm, cool, bw, pop), style (fade or ripple), dur (seconds to arrive), x, y (ripple origin, 0–1). Also works as a footage "look".
